recorded: idiom brief triage --json via claude-code claude-sonnet-5-5, rubric v1, 2026-10-31
request: Add a default Pinned group at the top of the Add drawer that users can customize.

response.reason: Adds a new group surface at the top of the Add drawer (new-control-or-surface, placement-or-timing), a customization interaction, a user-facing concept name ("Pinned"), and likely a per-item pin control.
questions: How do users add or remove items in Pinned: a per-item pin control on every drawer item, drag into the group, or a menu? How large is that control next to the item row, and does it increase row height?
Is the pin control visible all the time or only on hover? How does it work on touch (no hover) and from the keyboard (focus order, shortcut, accessible label)?
What does Pinned contain by default before the user customizes it (empty, a preset list, or recent/frequent items), and how does an empty state look and read compared with real items?
Can users reorder items within Pinned, and how (drag handle, keyboard move up/down, touch long-press)?
Is 'Pinned' the right user-facing name for the group, and does it match any existing term for favorites or pins elsewhere in the product?
Does Pinned stay fixed at the top when the drawer is scrolled or searched, and are pinned items also shown in their original group (duplicated) or moved out?
How much drawer space does Pinned take: is there a maximum number of pinned items, does it collapse, and how does it affect how many other items fit without scrolling?
Is the customization stored per user or per workspace/device, and is there a way to reset Pinned to its default?
